name.ja: 線形Maxwell電磁場（真空・誘電体）
name.en: Linear Maxwell fields in vacuum and dielectrics

note.ja: 代表式は3D線形電磁場です。今回の実装はz不変の円柱Ez/Hx/Hyに制限した真2D Yee計算です。 c=ε0=μ0=1。無限円柱のEz偏光、半径0.25、比誘電率2.25、真空波長1。6×6領域と4辺PML、明示的な節点階段状形状です。
note.en: The representative equations describe three-dimensional linear electromagnetics. This implementation is restricted to a z-invariant, genuinely two-dimensional Yee cylinder problem with Ez/Hx/Hy. Use c = epsilon0 = mu0 = 1, an infinite cylinder with Ez polarization, radius 0.25, relative permittivity 2.25 and vacuum wavelength 1. The 6 × 6 domain has four-side PML and an explicitly nodal staircase geometry.

note.en: Analytic reference Lossless infinite cylinder, Ez polarization, c = epsilon0 = mu0 = 1, radius 0.25, epsilon = 2.25 and vacuum wavelength 1. The analytical field is exterior to the exact circle. This is a lossless two-dimensional Ez cylinder, not a three-dimensional sphere. Report staircase geometry error without claiming general second-order curved-boundary accuracy or precision scattering for arbitrary frequencies and materials.
